cohort: 162,100 reproductive-aged women who underwent endometrial ablation and had a subsequent delivery between 1999 and 2016, compared to a control group of women with a delivery and no prior ablation.
finding: Pregnancies that occurred after endometrial ablation were associated with increased rates of morbidly adherent placenta (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 20.22, p < 0.0001).
